state.seed_assertion: Asset ID should be a formal identifier from an asset hierarchy rather than just the equipment name, so that reports aggregate correctly.

sentences.1: Asset ID should be a formal identifier from an asset hierarchy rather than just the equipment name, so that reports aggregate correctly.
sentences.4: A formal ID from your asset hierarchy so reports aggregate correctly.
sentences.5: A good maintenance log entry includes specific asset ID, date, work type, exact parts replaced, failure details, downtime duration, and technician name.
sentences.6: Asset name / IDTies every entry to a specific machine, not "the press"
sentences.7: Equipment should be assigned a stable, durable ID rather than identified primarily by name to ensure service records connect to the correct asset over time.
sentences.8: A durable asset tag for equipment gives the log a short operational key while the serial remains a secondary identifier.
